body:
Tested this in the Windows editor. It's definitely better, but I'm still getting a hang on exit about half the time, and 2 of my ~20 test runs ended up deadlocking when loading a scene (may be relevant that the scene's script included a `preload()` call for a material). I couldn't find a 100% repro for either.

And of course there are also the "Completed load for:..." debug prints - I assume those are gonna be removed, but I actually found them useful to identify what I end up blocking on - having those as a logging option would be neat.

I believe this is ready now.

Can you please help test again @max99x, @AdriaandeJongh, and @Chaosed0 

Much appreciated! <3

The root-cause of the issue you found was a pre-existing problem with TileSet specifically. I put a workaround in this PR now for the issue. The main problem is that when a TileSet gets loaded concurrently, the "losing" load takes ownership of the tileset resource. So when the scene is loaded it gets a TileSet resource but without the tileset resource, so the screen stays blank.

The crash was because in this situation there are callbacks for the old resource that is already deleted. 

Both of these issues appear to be long-standing, if I shrink the thread pool size both happen on master as well, and before prior fixes to ResourceLoader.
